---
title: "Standardized Yield Tables Used by the Newfoundland Classifier"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(knitr)


sim <- readRDS("E:/EasternCanadaClassifier/finalOut_NL.rds")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

```{r tables, results='asis'}

for (nm in names(sim$yieldTables_NL)) {

  cat("#", nm, "\n\n")

  dt <- copy(sim$yieldTables_NL[[nm]])

  dt[
    ,
    total := rowSums(
      .SD
    ),
    .SDcols = c(
      "blackSpruce_NL",
      "balsamFir_NL",
      "tamarack_NL",
      "otherConifer_NL",
      "broadleaf_NL"
    )
  ]

  setnames(dt, "AC10", "Age")

  print(
    kable(
      dt,
      digits = 2,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      align = "r"
    )
  )

  cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
}
```
